name: Wright State University
tuition_note: 2026-27 Ohio-resident undergraduate tuition & fees under the Wright Guarantee (standard rate for incoming students): $6,085/semester x 2 = $12,170/yr, from wright.edu/node/187106 (How much is tuition?). Housing room only: standard residence-hall Double (Hamilton Hall / The Woods) $2,878/semester x 2 = $5,756/yr from wright.edu/residence-life-and-housing/rates-and-agreements (2026-27). Board/dining is separate and not included; small per-person Communications ($200) and Activity ($60) fees also excluded. Non-Guarantee resident tuition rate is lower ($4,722/semester = $9,444/yr).
